news.text: Released ViSS and ChronoReplay, exploring supervision and evidence access for streaming video intelligence.
Released Trajectory2Gym: decision-grounded interaction synthesis for tool-use agents.
Released UltraText Bench, a bilingual benchmark for visual text rendering in image generation.
Started my Ph.D. in Artificial Intelligence at Westlake University.
Released SEAL and AtlasVA, studying agent–environment co-evolution and teacher-free visual skill memory.
Two papers, OmniVideo-R1 and Dual Latent Memory, are accepted by ICML 2026.
Released CFSR: geometry-conditioned shadow removal via physical disentanglement.
Released OmniVideo-R1 and Dual Latent Memory for visual multi-agent systems.
